Members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]], the Huskies were led by fifteenth-year head coach [[Lorenzo Romar]] and played their home games on campus at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] in [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]]. The Huskies finished the season 9–22, 2–16 in [[2016–17 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]], in eleventh place. In the [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], they lost in the first round to sixth-seeded [[2016–17 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]]. Romar was fired on March 15;{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/18916641/washington-huskies-fire-lorenzo-romar-9-22-season|title=Washington fires Romar after 9-22 season|work=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-03-16}} four days later, he was succeeded by [[Mike Hopkins (basketball)|Mike Hopkins]], a longtime assistant at [[2016–17 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] under {{nowrap|[[Jim Boeheim]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2017/03/19/washington-hires-mike-hopkins-syracuse-assistant-coach-in-waiting/99379902/|title=Washington hires Mike Hopkins, Syracuse's coach-in-waiting|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-03-21|language=en}}}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2015–16 season]] 19–15, 9–9 in [[2015–16 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12]] play to finish in a three-way for sixth place. The Huskies defeated [[2015–16 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Stanford]] in the first round of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]] in the quarterfinals. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as No. 3 seed. There they defeated [[2015–16 Long Beach State 49ers men's basketball team|Long Beach State]] in the first round before losing to [[2015–16 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] in the second round. ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
